fields.title: Blurby website with downloads
fields.description: One landing page at `blrby.app` on Cloudflare Pages: the Windows download (x64 or ARM64, chosen automatically, from the latest GitHub release), Google Play open-testing, Chrome Web Store and Firefox Add-ons links, privacy policy and terms, and the sign-in pages the server needs. The Windows installer is signed with Azure Trusted Signing. The download may go live right after the Stage 8 Windows release; sign-in pages follow BLURBY-SERVER-1 phase 2, and each store link is added as its listing goes live.
fields.notes: origin: held plan 2026-11-03-first-finish-line (website draft stub; absorbed by roadmap review 2026-11-03-2). Stub; needs /write-plan before dispatch. Owner accounts needed: Azure Trusted Signing (identity validation), Cloudflare Pages.
